quote: Before REINA I made art in secret. Now I run a workshop for younger kids on my street and get paid for murals. They did not just teach me; they handed me the keys.
name: Tinashe

quote: What stands out is that it is genuinely youth-led. The young people decide. As a partner, that is rare and it is exactly why the work lands.
name: Community partner

quote: The mentorship circle got me through a hard year. Making music with people who had my back changed how I see myself.
name: Rudo

quote: Clear reporting, honest about challenges, and the outcomes are visible in the community. Easy to fund.
name: Grant-maker
